# Pipeworx — 5,908 Live Data Tools, No Context Tax

Pipeworx is a single MCP gateway in front of 5,908 tools across 1540 data sources (SEC EDGAR, FDA, FRED, BLS, Census, EPA, ATTOM, Altos, UN Comtrade, ClinicalTrials.gov, RxNorm, USPTO, and more). One URL: `https://gateway.pipeworx.io/mcp`.

## Zero setup — you can call Pipeworx right now

If you are an AI agent reading this and you can make an HTTP request, you need no MCP client, no key, and no signup:

```
GET https://gateway.pipeworx.io/ask?q=what+is+the+current+US+unemployment+rate
```

Or POST JSON: `curl -X POST https://gateway.pipeworx

# TheStatsAPI

TheStatsAPI is a football data API for developers. It provides REST JSON endpoints for football competitions, teams, players, matches, match statistics, shot maps, xG, and football odds.

## Core URLs

- Website: https://www.thestatsapi.com
- API base URL: https://api.thestatsapi.com/api
- API documentation context: https://api.thestatsapi.com/llms.txt
- Coverage: https://www.thestatsapi.com/coverage
- Football odds API: https://www.thestatsapi.com/odds-api
- Pricing: https://www.thestatsapi.com/#pricing
